title: Recognition of a Tandem Lesion by DNA Glycosylases Explored Combining Molecular Dynamics and Machine Learning
authors: Emmanuelle Bignon; Natacha Gillet; Chen-Hui Chan; Tao Jiang; Antonio Monari; Elise Dumont
one_liner_zh: 该文结合微秒级分子动力学模拟与机器学习，研究DNA糖基化酶MutM对串联损伤DNA的识别机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系，但对象非TF-DNA。
abstract: The combination of several closely spaced DNA lesions, which can be induced by a single radical hit, constitutes a hallmark in the DNA damage landscape and radiation chemistry. The occurrence of such tandem base lesions give rise to a strong coupling with the double helix degrees of freedom and induce important structural deformations, in contrast to DNA strands containing a single oxidized nucleobase. Although such complex lesions are known to be refractory to repair by DNA glycosylases, there is still a lack of structural evidence to rationalize these phenomena. In this contribution, we explore, by numerical modeling and molecular simulations, the behavior of the bacterial glycosylase responsible for base excision repair (MutM), specialized in excising oxidatively-damaged defects such as 7,8-dihydro-8-oxoguanine (8-oxoG). The difference in lesion recognition between a simple damage and a tandem lesions featuring an additional abasic site is assessed at atomistic resolution owing to microsecond molecular dynamics simulation and machine learning postprocessing, allowing to extensively pinpoint crucial differences in the interaction patterns of the damaged bases. This work advocates for the use of such high throughput numerical simulations for exploring the complex combinatorial chemistry of tandem DNA lesions repair and more generally multiple damaged sites of the utmost significance in radiation chemistry.
abstract_zh: 由单一自由基撞击诱导产生的多个紧密相邻DNA损伤的组合，构成了DNA损伤图谱和辐射化学中的一个标志性特征。这种串联碱基损伤的出现，与双螺旋自由度产生强烈耦合，并引发重要的结构变形，这与含有单一氧化碱基的DNA链形成鲜明对比。尽管已知这类复杂损伤对DNA糖基化酶的修复具有抗性，但缺乏结构证据来合理化这些现象。在本研究中，我们通过数值建模和分子模拟，探讨了负责碱基切除修复的细菌糖基化酶（MutM）的行为，该酶专门切除氧化损伤缺陷，如7,8-二氢-8-氧代鸟嘌呤（8-oxoG）。通过微秒级分子动力学模拟和机器学习后处理，在原子分辨率下评估了简单损伤与含有额外脱碱基位点的串联损伤之间的识别差异，从而广泛地指出了受损碱基相互作用模式中的关键差异。这项工作倡导使用此类高通量数值模拟，以探索串联DNA损伤修复的复杂组合化学，以及更广泛地在辐射化学中具有极其重要意义的多重损伤位点。
